_comment: The single source for which mods a release carries and which files of each. Read by build_release.ps1 (what to copy), check_release.ps1 and check_release_linux.py (what may be in a package). A file ships only if its path inside the mod matches one of the mod's 'allow' regexes (forward slashes, matched against the whole path). Nothing else under mods/ is allowed, so a new kind of file has to be added here on purpose. 'default_on' mods are listed in the package's mods/enabled.txt; the others are installed but off (the launcher's Mods tab turns them on). 'optional' mods are only packaged when build_release.ps1 is asked for them. 'source' is relative to the melee checkout. 'required' lists files a mod must carry for it to work (Envoy's shaders, the drive models): packaging refuses to stage a mod that lacks one and both guards fail a package that does.

geno-lab.why: The LAB (SOLO > LAB). Lua, its own UI textures and lab_ui.json; art/ and preview sources stay out.

envoy.why: Envoy mode. Lua (.lua), post-pass and effect shaders (.wgsl), item definitions, effect packages and mission tables (.json, .txt). Internal planning notes (*.md other than README.md) stay out.

envoy_drives.why: Envoy's original drive models: meshes and textures (.gxmesh, .gxtex) and their material and collision JSON. tools/make_drives.py (the generator) stays out.

vanilla-hero.why: Not shipped (owner, 2026-10-07: no custom fighters in a release yet). Geno sample fighter on the retail Mario files from the player's own disc. Text only: define (.json), move scripts (.genoasm, .words). Off: it adds a roster slot and its looks and feel are unreviewed.

vanilla-striker.why: Not shipped (owner, 2026-10-07: no custom fighters in a release yet). Geno sample fighter with its own move set. Text only (.json, .genoasm, .words, effect package .json). Off: unreviewed looks and feel.

vanilla-caster.why: Not shipped (owner, 2026-10-07: no custom fighters in a release yet). Geno sample fighter with its own article and effect. Text only. Off: a fixture that proves the machinery, not a move set.

vanilla-courier.why: The Courier: an original fighter on its own model and animation bank. Built files (.dat) are original art made by tools/geno/build_courier.sh and are NOT in git; only packaged with -IncludeCourier, only when every .dat matches the build record, and listed in mods/original-assets.json. Never on by default.
